podcast.title: Predecessor to Lowest of the Low
podcast.body: Popular Front was an 80s band that eventually evolved into Lowest of the Low. They unsuccessfully sought a major record deal before transforming into their more well-known incarnation. "They evolved out of an 80s band called Popular Front and tried to get a major record deal, but were rejected by used to everybody."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Evolution from Popular Front
xref.body: Lowest of the Low originated from an 80s band called Popular Front. They attempted to secure a major record deal as Popular Front, and again in 1991 as Lowest of the Low, but were consistently rejected by major labels. "They evolved out of an 80s band called Popular Front and tried to get a major record deal, but were rejected by used to everybody."
